newsitem.title: DUBAI: Ekeus holds talks with Saudi foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Ekeus holds talks with Saudi foreign minister.

text.p: The U.N. official charged with eliminating Iraq's weapons of mass destruction met with Saudi Arabia's foreign minister on Monday and briefed him on the work of his commission, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said.
Rolf Ekeus met with Prince Saud al-Faisal at the foreign ministry in Riyadh, SPA said.

"He gave a full description of the actions and tasks of this commission," set up by the U.N. Security Council to supervise the scrapping of Iraqi weapons of mass destruction, SPA said. It gave no further details.

Ekeus is on a tour of Gulf Arab states, and left Kuwait for Saudi Arabia on Sunday. Diplomats have said Ekeus was on the Gulf tour to secure funds for his cash-strapped commission, which was set up after the Gulf war in 1991.
Ekeus has said his commission needed $30 million for 1997.
